test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, ‘Other Religions and Persuasions’ formed what percentage of the country’s population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.7%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, 'Other Religions and Persuasions' formed **0.7%** of the country's population.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and collects demographic, social, and economic information on the Indian population.
 
• 'Other Religions and Persuasions' is a category that includes smaller religious groups not classified under major religions like Hinduism, Islam, Christianity, Sikhism, Buddhism, and Jainism.
 
• This category helps in recognizing the diverse religious practices and beliefs present within the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is one of the largest administrative exercises in the world, providing crucial data for planning and policy-making.
 
• The census data is used for various purposes including the allocation of resources, representation in legislative bodies, and development planning.
 
• India's Census is conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The 2011 Census was the 15th National Census of the country since 1872 and the 7th after independence.
 
• The next Census of India was scheduled for 2021 but was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
